Pushed successfully. Task complete. Summary:

**Real target repo was `claude-control`** (not this compliance-tracker workspace, despite the branch name matching) — the 20-engine/Auditor-Engine files only exist there.

- Re-ran `ai-os-scripts/generate_engines_gateways_inventory.py` against live disk: 18/20 rows unchanged, zero drift.
- **Engine 8 (Workflow Engine)**: added `veridian-task.py` and `supervisor-entrypoint.sh` to `exists_as` (genuinely live), documented the `HOLD_FOR_OWNER_SIGNOFF` fix (PR #81) and the `credit-accountant.py` propose-call fix (PR #82) — both still open/unmerged.
- **Engine 5 (Policy Engine)**: documented the DDL gate (PR #79) and interactive write-gate (PR #80) in `gap_description` but deliberately did *not* add them to `exists_as`, since neither is live-deployed yet and doing so would have falsely flipped `verified_on_disk` for the row's other genuinely-live paths.
- **Real duplication found and reported (not fixed)**: `preflight-guard.py` and PR #82's new `task-gateway.py cmd_start` call both independently invoke `credit-accountant.py propose` for the same `task_id` — flagged as a genuine overlap needing its own follow-up task.
- **Auditor Engine**: read the full phase plan and cross-checked all 9 phases (0–8) against 8 real PRs via `gh pr view` — all confirmed MERGED, not just self-reported.
- No 21st engine added, no new tracking file created, PR left open (not self-merged).

Opened **[claude-control PR #83](https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/83)** with the update-in-place changes and full report. Also registered/closed the claim in this repo's `ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` and updated `PROGRESS.md` per protocol.
